✨ deviload | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A desktop application for easily downloading and managing video and audio content from online sources, with a focus on YouTube.
✨ Key Features: • Downloads from YouTube and other yt-dlp supported sites • Supports various video and audio formats (MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, FLAC, WAV) • One-click download with link preview (title, duration, streams) • Playlist management (whole list, ranges, chapter splitting)
📖 Summary: Deviload is a clean, user-friendly desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading videos and audio from various online platforms. It leverages yt-dlp for robust downloading capabilities, offering features like playlist management, chapter splitting, GIF creation, and direct YouTube sign-in.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 CryptoClipGuard | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Protecting cryptocurrency users from clipboard hijacking malware by detecting and reverting malicious address replacements in real-time.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time clipboard monitoring • Detects BTC, ETH, SOL, and USDT (TRC20) addresses • Automatically blocks and reverts malicious clipboard replacements • Desktop notifications on hijack detection
📖 Summary: CryptoClipGuard is a Python-based Windows utility that acts as a real-time clipboard monitor and protector. It specifically targets cryptocurrency users by detecting and preventing clipboard hijacking attacks, where malicious software attempts to replace copied crypto addresses with attacker-controlled ones.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 httptrafficmonitr | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To capture, inspect, filter, replay, mock, and export HTTP/HTTPS traffic on Windows, with advanced control and automation capabilities for developers and AI assistants.
✨ Key Features: • System-wide HTTP/HTTPS capture with TLS interception • Live request grid with filtering and search • Detailed request/response inspection tabs (Request, Response, Timing, Certificate, Decoded) • Advanced multi-condition filtering with saved presets
📖 Summary: HTTP Traffic Monitor is a Windows desktop application that functions as a man-in-the-middle proxy for capturing, inspecting, and manipulating HTTP/HTTPS traffic. It features a WPF-based UI for detailed analysis and an MCP server interface for AI assistants to control and interact with the traffic data.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 hingewave | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a visually engaging and interactive animation that mimics the folding motion of a device's lid or hinge on the screen, enhancing the user experience for laptops and foldables.
✨ Key Features: • iPhone Duo fold animation effect • Cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Android) • Real-time synchronization with device hinge angle • GPU-accelerated rendering • One-command installation scripts
📖 Summary: Hingewave is a cross-platform application that creates a dynamic fold animation effect for laptop lids and foldable devices. It synchronizes screen visuals with the physical hinge's angle, offering a unique aesthetic for macOS, Windows, and Android.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
